claims: Michael B. Jordan stars in Sinners.
Sinners is a 2025 Southern Gothic horror film.
Sinners is directed by Ryan Coogler.
Michael B. Jordan plays twin brothers Elijah "Smoke" Moore and Elias "Stack" Moore in Sinners.
Sinners is set in 1932 in the Mississippi Delta.
Michael B. Jordan's performance in Sinners features distinct movements for each twin.
Michael B. Jordan uses distinct separate approaches to embody the different personalities of Elijah "Smoke" Moore and Elias "Stack" Moore.
Michael B. Jordan won the Best Actor Oscar in 2026.
Sinners won four 2026 Oscars including Best Actor for Michael B. Jordan.
Sinners is written by Ryan Coogler.
Sinners marks another collaboration between Ryan Coogler and Michael B. Jordan following Creed and Black Panther.
Michael B. Jordan won his first Oscar becoming the first performer in over 50 years to win a lead actor award for playing twins according to the Los Angeles Times.
Sinners secured four Academy Awards including Best Cinematography and Best Original Score as noted by the NewarkNJBlog on Facebook.
Sinners received a record 16 Oscar nominations according to the Los Angeles Times and The Hollywood Reporter.
